title: Testing Whether the Misalignment Direction Is Consistent Across Layers or Concentrated in Specific Layers

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Layer localization enables minimal targeted interventions rather than model-wide corrections. Practical value for efficient safety editing. Informs whether safety training can focus on specific layers.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires extracting activations at every layer, computing misalignment direction per layer, and performing layer-specific ablations. The activation_steering.py script helps but the analytical complexity is meaningful for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: No training needed if using existing misaligned models, but the per-layer analysis and ablation experiments are substantial. Multiple ablation conditions (one per layer) multiply the evaluation work. Clear deliverable but analytically dense.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
